purpose_context: The doc-kitty MVP is feature-complete and cut at 0.1.0, but its reuse is proven only at N=1 (the spec-kitty brand theme) and it has never been build-proven from a clean install as an external adopter would consume it. This mission builds a consumption-test CI workflow that packs the toolkit and installs the tarball into a fixture consumer site carrying a representative slice of the ars-rethorica book under a new editorial consumer theme, closing the two gaps the adoption study still flags: no install-provable release and single-consumer reuse.
purpose_tldr: Prove the packaged toolkit installs cleanly into a net-new consumer site, enforced by CI, and demonstrate the consumer theme layer at N=2.
